description: One dashboard for fleet overview and individual-pod diagnosis. Workload=All and Pod=All show the combined selection; choose a workload or pod to narrow it. Include old pods adds retired replicas observed in the selected period. Compare workloads in the table; use Current pods to inspect a replica. Counters sum process observations after reset handling, percentiles use combined buckets, and shared balances are not added across replicas. Missing data remains unknown.

spec.title: Decision counts
spec.description: Every parsed auction contributes one bounded terminal decision. Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Hot-path latency
spec.description: Percentiles of combined histogram buckets across selected workloads. Per-workload p95 remains in Workload details; percentiles are not averaged. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Bid amount funnel
spec.description: Bid amounts recorded at each lifecycle stage during the selected interval, in ETH. These are stage totals, not realised profit or a deduplicated amount across stages. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Count conversion
spec.description: Per-workload ratios of event counts within the selected interval. No activity means a zero denominator; missing metrics stay empty. These are interval ratios, not matched auction cohorts; lifecycle stages may cross time or workload boundaries. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="auction",outcome="enqueued"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) / sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="auction"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))) >= 0) or ((sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="auction"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) == 0) - 1)

((sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_success"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) / sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))) >= 0) or ((sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="won"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: Feed connection history
spec.description: Feed continuity over the selected time range. Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Activity ages
spec.description: Current state-refresh age and ages of the latest bid lifecycle timestamps observed in the interval. Zero timestamps mean Not observed; missing samples stay empty. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Won obligations
spec.description: Winning reservations still awaiting settlement. Values are shown per namespace/workload across matching scrape targets. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Unresolved / failed / unsafe lifecycle
spec.description: Event counts in the selected interval for unresolved wins, breaker failures and failed settlements. deposit_below_floor is a current 0/1 flag, not an event count. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="unresolved"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")), "signal", "unresolved_win", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="breaker",outcome="failure"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")), "signal", "breaker_failure", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_failed"}[$__range]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")), "signal", "failed_settlement", "", "") or label_replace(max by (namespace, workload) (label_replace(oev_deposit_below_floor{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""}, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")), "signal", "deposit_below_floor", "", "")

spec.title: Feeds connected
spec.description: Connected feeds / currently observed OEV workloads. Missing feed samples do not count as connected. Retired workloads are excluded from the denominator. Current value at the end of the selected time range. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.expr: sum(min by (namespace, pod) (oev_feed_connected{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!=""})) / count(max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${instance}",pod!="",solver="redstone-oev"}))

spec.title: Auctions
spec.description: Total or ratio over the time range selected above. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Bids enqueued
spec.description: Total or ratio over the time range selected above. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Wins · period
spec.description: Total or ratio over the time range selected above. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Settled · period
spec.description: Total or ratio over the time range selected above. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Min deposit
spec.description: Minimum current Executor deposit across selected workloads, in ETH. Replicas may share one signer and deposit; their balances are not additive. Inspect individual observations in Workload details. Current value at the end of the selected time range. Pod All aggregates the listed replicas by workload. Period counters add process observations; they do not deduplicate business events. Shared state and account balances are not summed across replicas.

spec.title: Workload comparison
spec.description: Compare the selected workloads. Period counts cover the selected pods and time range; readiness, backlog and balances describe current samples. Click a workload to aggregate its listed pods.

spec.title: Current pods
spec.description: Pods reporting at the end of the selected range, across the selected workloads. This list stays independent of the Pod filter so you can switch replicas. Click a pod to inspect it.

spec.expr: (label_replace(min by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_service_ready{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?",pod!=""}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) and on (namespace, pod) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

(label_replace(min by (namespace, pod) ((time() - process_start_time_seconds{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?",pod!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")) and on (namespace, pod) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"))

title: Vault Solver · RedStone OEV

spec.name: history
spec.label: Include old pods
spec.description: Off: pods reporting at the end of the selected time range. On: also include pods observed earlier in that range. This changes the chooser only; panel time ranges stay unchanged.

spec.name: workloads
spec.label: Workload

spec.query: query_result(max by (workload) (label_replace((max by (pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!=""}) or (max by (pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!=""}[$__range])) and on () (vector(${history}) == 1))), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")))

spec.definition: query_result(max by (workload) (label_replace((max by (pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!=""}) or (max by (pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!=""}[$__range])) and on () (vector(${history}) == 1))), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?")))
spec.description: Choose the deployment first. The Pod chooser contains only its replicas. All lists replicas across the available workloads; Overview links retain that selection.

spec.name: instance
spec.label: Pod

spec.query: query_result(max by (pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!="",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}) or (max by (pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!="",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}[$__range])) and on () (vector(${history}) == 1)))

spec.definition: query_result(max by (pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!="",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}) or (max by (pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_solver_info{solver="redstone-oev",namespace="${namespace}",pod!="",pod=~"(${workloads})(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?"}[$__range])) and on () (vector(${history}) == 1)))
spec.description: Choose one pod, or All to aggregate the pods listed for this workload. Include old pods adds retired replicas to the selected set. Short labels keep full pod names as values.
